prompts.shield:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production 2D game animation sprite sheet, actual sequential animation keyframes.
Input image 1 is the exact character design and rendering style reference. Preserve this character faithfully.
Canvas: EXACT 2048 x 2560 pixels, genuinely transparent alpha background. EXACTLY FOUR columns and FIVE rows of equal invisible 512x512 cells, exactly TWENTY separate full-body frames. No grid lines, labels, text, background, ground shadow, painted ground rings, muzzleflash or expansive effects. Entire silhouette remains inside its own cell with at least 40 pixels empty padding; no overlap.
Camera and registration: EVERY frame uses IDENTICAL rear three-quarter oblique view facing upper-right as the supplied reference, consistent body proportions and costume, identical character scale and baseline of planted foot across all upright frames. Never flip, mirror, rotate to front view, change viewing direction or move sideways. Only limbs and body articulate. This is one coherent animation sequence, not twenty unrelated poses.
Read order LEFT TO RIGHT then TOP TO BOTTOM: Row1 cells0-3 first half of an eight-frame walk-in-place loop. Row2 cells4-7 second half of SAME walk loop, alternating steps, feet visibly articulate, tiny body sway, character never translates. Row3 cells8-11 four sequential basic attack frames: windup, extension, impact/recoil, recovery into ready. Row4 cells12-15 four sequential special action frames: preparation, execution, followthrough, recover. Row5 cells16-19 four sequential death frames: stumble, knees buckle, collapse onto side, final stable body lying on the ground. Death must actually lower body and finish fully horizontal on the ground; no disintegration, no standing ghost.
Style: match reference polished handpainted 2D outlined cutout game art, highly consistent details, clean transparent edges. No alternative costumes or additional characters.
Subject: huge bald muscular tank, olive green heavy armor, utility pouches, BLUE riot shield with the reference white emblem and short BLACK baton. Shield stays in original anatomical hand and baton stays opposite, as reference. Basic attack is a forward shield bash toward upper-right. Special is bracing shield in front then absorbing impact with a slight recoil. Keep shield and baton clearly attached and recognizable throughout, including death.
